prior_paper: Liu, Y., Liu, X., & Liu, Z. (2022). Effects of climate change on paddy expansion and potential adaption strategies for sustainable agriculture development across Northeast China. Applied Geography, 141, 102667.
what_it_demonstrates: Cold-margin paddy expansion has occurred under warming with water constraints
what_it_does_not: Transferability to regions without paddy tradition; multi-gate separation
contribution_of_this_study: Separates thermal transfer from irrigation infrastructure and rainfed balance in a region with almost no paddy; weights by incumbent arable land
remaining_limitations: Do not imply Europe will follow the NE China trajectory

prior_paper: Yang, J., Hu, Q., You, L., Cai, Z., Chen, Y., & Wei, H. (2023). Mapping the potential northern limits and promotion extent of ratoon rice in China. Applied Geography, 150, 102822.
what_it_demonstrates: Thermal limits are system-specific and mappable
what_it_does_not: Sensitivity of the limit to data source, window and resolution
contribution_of_this_study: Shows that a system-specific cold bound shifts by ~300 GDD10 between data sources and that inference depends on calibration on the same grid
evidence_level: modeled thresholds validated on observed planting
remaining_limitations: Closest methodological competitor; novelty must not be claimed for threshold mapping per se

prior_paper: Gao, J., & Liu, Y. (2011). Climate warming and land use change in Heilongjiang Province, Northeast China. Applied Geography, 31, 476–482.
what_it_demonstrates: Warming co-occurs with northward rice/paddy land use change
contribution_of_this_study: We do not claim observed change; we provide a pre-feasibility screen
remaining_limitations: Avoid implying causal policy or climate effects

prior_paper: Mahmood, R., Legates, D. R., & Meo, M. (2004). The role of soil water availability in potential rainfed rice productivity in Bangladesh: Applications of the CERES-Rice model. Applied Geography, 24, 139–159.
what_it_demonstrates: Rainfed rice productivity is water-limited even in monsoon climate
contribution_of_this_study: Daily bucket and grid climatic balance for temperate rainfed upland rice, cross-validated (Spearman 0.73)
remaining_limitations: Our bucket is simpler than CERES; results are modeled stress, not yield

prior_paper: Safanelli, J. L., et al. (2023). Grain-cropping suitability for evaluating the agricultural land use change in Brazil. Applied Geography, 154, 102937.
what_it_demonstrates: Suitability layers can be compared against observed land-use change
contribution_of_this_study: Adds cultivation-system-specific gates and a food-supply risk layer
remaining_limitations: Our study does not test against observed change

prior_paper: Cornwell, E., Sposito, V., & Faggian, R. (2020). Land suitability projections for traditional sub-alpine cropping in the Australian Alps and Chilean Dry Andes. Applied Geography, 121, 102248.
what_it_demonstrates: Climate-analogue suitability for specific cropping systems
remaining_limitations: Projection framing should not be imported—we use baseline climate

prior_paper: Xu, E., & Zhang, H. (2013). Spatially-explicit sensitivity analysis for land suitability evaluation. Applied Geography, 45, 1–9.

what_it_does_not: Sensitivity to data source, window and resolution
contribution_of_this_study: Quantifies threshold, window, source and aggregation sensitivity of a single binding gate
